description: V11 deterministic contract suite for perception-aware adaptive execution.

tasks.objective: Oversized tool output is stored by content hash and retrieved through bounded evidence references.
Context allocation adapts by evidence role and visual/browser/risk signals without exceeding the task budget.
Stable prompt material has a deterministic prefix hash while task/evidence remains dynamic.
Visual work requires a vision-capable candidate instead of blindly escalating numeric model tiers.
Element position and size requirements produce deterministic PASS/FAIL geometry receipts.
PNG comparison reports exact changed pixel bounds and supports focused failure crops without external dependencies.
Responsive verification uses a bounded representative viewport matrix and reports viewport-specific failures.
Browser QA requests targeted semantic/geometry evidence instead of repeated full-page snapshots.
Webpage content is explicitly untrusted and cannot change permissions, request secrets or authorize external side effects.
Deterministic tasks avoid agent fan-out and overlapping writers are serialized into dependency-safe waves.
Skill entrypoints are linted for size, metadata and description collisions before promotion.
Hermes stays optional, bounded and subordinate to UES durable state and safety boundaries.
